holdout.construction: old response-training games only; sha256('negotiation-risk-selector-v1'|game_id) mod 5 == 0; whole games
holdout.opponent_overlap_note: The dense public cross-play graph reuses model identities in every split; identity is not a response-model feature.
holdout.reason: All public games at authoritative source commit 68a33e98 were already used by response-model train/calibration/test. The public HEAD is unchanged; retraining was forbidden absent a model defect.

objective.dominance: remove A when B risk value >= A-0.01 and q_accept(B)>=q_accept(A)+0.1
objective.loss: L=-Y; CVaR_alpha is mean of largest losses over worst 1-alpha mass
objective.optimization_distribution: branch raw payoffs transformed to negotiation Y

parameter_selection_rule: best fresh-to-selector mean percentile proxy among sanity-feasible combinations within 5% of best expected raw payoff
